23/// A data filter.
24#[derive(Debug, Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
25pub enum Filter {
26    /// ASCII hexadecimal encoding.
27    AsciiHexDecode,
28    /// ASCII base-85 encoding.
29    Ascii85Decode,
30    /// Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) compression.
31    LzwDecode,
32    /// DEFLATE compression (zlib/gzip).
33    FlateDecode,
34    /// Run-length encoding compression.
35    RunLengthDecode,
36    /// CCITT Group 3 or Group 4 fax compression.
37    CcittFaxDecode,
38    /// JBIG2 compression for bi-level images.
39    Jbig2Decode,
40    /// JPEG (DCT) compression.
41    DctDecode,
42    /// JPEG 2000 compression.
43    JpxDecode,
44    /// Encryption filter.
45    Crypt,
46}
47
48impl Filter {
49    fn debug_name(&self) -> &'static str {
50        match self {
51            Self::AsciiHexDecode => "ascii_hex",
52            Self::Ascii85Decode => "ascii_85",
53            Self::LzwDecode => "lzw",
54            Self::FlateDecode => "flate",
55            Self::RunLengthDecode => "run-length",
56            Self::CcittFaxDecode => "ccit_fax",
57            Self::Jbig2Decode => "jbig2",
58            Self::DctDecode => "dct",
59            Self::JpxDecode => "jpx",
60            Self::Crypt => "crypt",
61        }
62    }
63
64    pub(crate) fn from_name(name: Name<'_>) -> Option<Self> {
65        match name.deref() {
66            ASCII_HEX_DECODE | ASCII_HEX_DECODE_ABBREVIATION => Some(Self::AsciiHexDecode),
67            ASCII85_DECODE | ASCII85_DECODE_ABBREVIATION => Some(Self::Ascii85Decode),
68            LZW_DECODE | LZW_DECODE_ABBREVIATION => Some(Self::LzwDecode),
69            FLATE_DECODE | FLATE_DECODE_ABBREVIATION => Some(Self::FlateDecode),
70            RUN_LENGTH_DECODE | RUN_LENGTH_DECODE_ABBREVIATION => Some(Self::RunLengthDecode),
71            CCITTFAX_DECODE | CCITTFAX_DECODE_ABBREVIATION => Some(Self::CcittFaxDecode),
72            JBIG2_DECODE => Some(Self::Jbig2Decode),
73            DCT_DECODE | DCT_DECODE_ABBREVIATION => Some(Self::DctDecode),
74            JPX_DECODE => Some(Self::JpxDecode),
75            CRYPT => Some(Self::Crypt),
76            _ => {
77                warn!("unknown filter: {}", name.as_str());
78
79                None
80            }
81        }
82    }
83
84    /// PdfCraft patch: `limit` is the most bytes the filter may produce (see `decode_limit`), and
85    /// `rows` the `/Height` of the image whose samples it produces, when it is an image's last
86    /// filter.
87    pub(crate) fn apply(
88        &self,
89        data: &[u8],
90        params: &Dict<'_>,
91        image_params: &ImageDecodeParams,
92        limit: usize,
93        rows: Option<usize>,
94    ) -> Result<FilterResult<'static>, DecodeFailure> {
95        let res = match self {
96            Self::AsciiHexDecode => ascii_hex::decode(data).map(FilterResult::from_data).ok_or(DecodeFailure::StreamDecode),
97            Self::Ascii85Decode => ascii_85::decode(data, limit).map(FilterResult::from_data).ok_or(DecodeFailure::StreamDecode),
98            Self::RunLengthDecode => run_length::decode(data, limit).map(FilterResult::from_data).ok_or(DecodeFailure::StreamDecode),
99            Self::LzwDecode => lzw_flate::lzw::decode(data, params, limit).map(FilterResult::from_data).ok_or(DecodeFailure::StreamDecode),
100            Self::FlateDecode => lzw_flate::flate::decode(data, params, limit, rows).map(FilterResult::from_data).ok_or(DecodeFailure::StreamDecode),
101            Self::DctDecode => dct::decode(data, params, image_params).ok_or(DecodeFailure::ImageDecode),
102            Self::CcittFaxDecode => ccitt::decode(data, params, image_params).ok_or(DecodeFailure::ImageDecode),
103            Self::Jbig2Decode => jbig2::decode(data, params, image_params).ok_or(DecodeFailure::ImageDecode),
104            Self::JpxDecode => jpx::decode(data, image_params).ok_or(DecodeFailure::ImageDecode),
105            #[cfg(any())]
106            Self::DctDecode | Self::CcittFaxDecode | Self::Jbig2Decode | Self::JpxDecode => {
107                warn!("image decoding is not supported (enable the `images` feature)");
108                Err(DecodeFailure::ImageDecode)
109            }
110            // PdfCraft patch (30): `Stream::raw_data` decrypted the data with the filter this names.
111            Self::Crypt => Ok(FilterResult::from_data(data.to_vec())),
112        };
113
114        if res.is_err() {
115            warn!("failed to apply filter {}", self.debug_name());
116        }
117
118        res
119    }
120}

122/// PdfCraft patch: the most bytes Flate, LZW or RunLength may produce for a stream that isn't an
123/// image of known size: content streams, fonts, forms, ICC profiles. These filters expand without
124/// limit (Flate about 1000:1), so a 2 MB page that inflated to 2 GB took the renderer past 3 GB in
125/// under a second. They never write past the limit (the buffer can still grow to under twice
126/// it). Real streams are far smaller; the same figure bounds lopdf's load-time decoding.
127pub const MAX_DECODED_STREAM: usize = 256 << 20;
128
129/// PdfCraft patch: the most bytes they may produce for an image of known size, however large it
130/// says it is.
131const MAX_DECODED_IMAGE: u64 = 1 << 30;
132
133/// PdfCraft patch: the output limit for one filter of a stream decoded with `params`; `last`
134/// says whether it is the last filter. The last filter of an image whose size, bits per
135/// component and components are known produces its pixels, plus at most one PNG predictor tag
136/// byte per pixel byte (a predictor row can be as short as one byte): bytes past that are never
137/// drawn. Earlier filters produce compressed data, which can be larger than the pixels, and
138/// everything else gets [`MAX_DECODED_STREAM`]. Decoding stops at the limit and keeps what it
139/// has.
140pub(crate) fn decode_limit(params: &ImageDecodeParams, last: bool) -> usize {
141    let (true, Some(bpc), Some(components)) = (last, params.bpc, params.num_components) else {
142        return MAX_DECODED_STREAM;
143    };
144    if params.width == 0 || params.height == 0 {
145        return MAX_DECODED_STREAM;
146    }
147    let bits = u64::from(params.width) * u64::from(components) * u64::from(bpc);
148    let pixels = bits.div_ceil(8).saturating_mul(u64::from(params.height));
149    let image = pixels.saturating_mul(2).min(MAX_DECODED_IMAGE);
150    usize::try_from(image).unwrap_or(MAX_DECODED_STREAM)
151}

153/// PdfCraft patch: whether a CCITT image of `columns` × `rows` may be decoded. The decoder sizes
154/// its line buffers from `/Columns`, which a fuzzed file set to 4294967295 (a 4 GiB allocation);
155/// real fax lines are a few thousand pixels wide.
156pub fn ccitt_size_ok(columns: u32, rows: u32) -> bool {
157    const MAX_COLUMNS: u32 = 1 << 20;
158    const MAX_PIXELS: u64 = 1 << 28;
159    columns > 0 && columns <= MAX_COLUMNS && u64::from(columns) * u64::from(rows.max(1)) <= MAX_PIXELS
160}
